about: Christopher H. Bayley is an attorney who represents clients in the Phoenix, Arizona area. Christopher Bayley is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2008 - 2009. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Christopher Bayley chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of San Diego School of Law and graduated in 1986. Christopher Bayley passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1986.
He represents clients with Bankruptcy: Business issues in Arizona.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Christopher Bayley has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
